summary: Navios Maritime Partners L.P., a Marshall Islands limited partnership listed on the NYSE and filing as a foreign private issuer, submitted a Form 6-K on October 5, 2026, solely to announce that its 2026 annual meeting of limited partners will be held on Friday, December 18, 2026, at a time and place to be specified in the definitive proxy materials. The Greek-domiciled shipping company filed no transaction, ownership, price, or strategic terms; no board recommendation or advisor is disclosed beyond the meeting date. This is a routine meeting notice, equivalent to a US annual meeting announcement, with no special-situations or risk-arb angle to watch.
